details: Logger built once from filter directives (as RUST_LOG would give them). Each call builds a Metadata with the namespace as target and calls Logger::enabled; there is no logger per namespace. The namespace is read out of the fixture before timing. Logger::enabled only delegates to the env_filter crate (2.0, a dependency of env_logger), so this entry and the env_filter one time the same matching code. The match is a few prefix comparisons, so the figure is close to the cost of the harness loop.
